definitions.explanation: A state of being full of life and activity; energetic atmosphere.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}は{活気|かっき}がある。
examples.notes: {活気|かっき}がある is a common expression

examples.japanese: {市場|いちば}は{活気|かっき}にあふれていた。
examples.english: The market was full of energy.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}に{活気|かっき}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す。
examples.english: To bring vitality back to the company.

notes:
{活気|かっき} means vigor, liveliness, or energy. It describes an energetic atmosphere or state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {活気|かっき}がある (to be lively/energetic)
- {活気|かっき}にあふれる (to be full of vitality)
- {活気|かっき}づく (to become lively)
- {活気|かっき}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す (to regain vitality)

USAGE:
- Describes places: {活気|かっき}のある{街|まち} (lively town)
- Describes atmospheres: {活気|かっき}のある{職場|しょくば} (energetic workplace)
- Describes economy: {経済|けいざい}に{活気|かっき}がない (the economy lacks vigor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {元気|げんき}: personal energy/health
- {活気|かっき}: atmosphere/environment energy
- {活力|かつりょく}: vitality (more formal)
